Agronomist, member of the Ordre des agronomes du Québec. 15 years of experience in agri-environmental work and agricultural regulation in Quebec.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Agricultural potential and CPTAQ applications

An application to the Commission de protection du territoire agricole du Québec (CPTAQ) — subdivision, transfer, rezoning, resource extraction — rests largely on the agricultural potential of the lot in question. I establish this diagnostic and support the filing of the application with the Commission.

**Who this is for**: landowners, developers, municipalities, and MRCs.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Water and soil health diagnostic

Recurring excess water, underperforming zones, soil structural condition: a diagnostic established before a site visit even happens. Potentially eligible for financial support under the Programme services-conseils.

**Who this is for**: farmers in active operation.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## PAEF and PAA

Agri-environmental fertilization plan (PAEF) and agri-environmental support plan (PAA) — two services I practiced for several years before specializing in geospatial data. Potentially eligible for financial support under the Programme services-conseils.

**Who this is for**: farmers in active operation.
